question: How much time (in seconds) does the earth take to rotate through an angle of 135 degrees about its axis?
solution:
**Given:**

Angle needed to rotate through = 135°

Concept used:

Earth revolves around its own axis in 24 hours (taking the round figure) i.e. 86400 seconds</p
